title: fix(runtime): on the standalone server every /actions verb reaches the actions domain, so an anonymous caller gets 401, and no Allow lists a verb mounted only to refuse
body:
Fixes #24228

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: every request whose answer changes is refused before and after. On the standalone server an anonymous non-`POST` request to `/api/v1/actions/...` moves from the HTTP adapter's `405` to the `actions` domain's `401`, and a request under a verb no route takes on `/keys`, the `/notifications` faces or `/mcp/skill` moves from the adapter's `405` (whose `Allow` listed refusal-only verbs) to the domain's own refusal. No verb that was refused is admitted, no route is added, and no accept set or export widens.

## What changed

- `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, three parts:
  1. **A declaration of the paths whose domain decides every verb** (`domainDecidesEveryVerb`). Each one is the serving route's verb and pattern, made beside that route: the three `POST /actions` patterns in `registerActionRoutes` (so both the unscoped and the `/environments/:environmentId` base), `POST /keys`, the three `/notifications` faces and `GET /mcp/skill`.
  2. **The dispatcher's existing fallback seam answers those paths.** `setFallbackHandler` runs only when the router matched no route, and before the adapter's own unmatched answer. When the transport's router resolves the request path, under a declared verb, to a declared pattern (`IHttpServer.resolveMountedRoute`, the router's own verdict, no second matcher), the request goes to `dispatch()` as `createHonoApp`'s catch-all sends it: `req.method`, the whole sub-path after the prefix (so `dispatch()` reads the environment off a scoped path, since an unrouted request has no route params), `req.query`, and no body. The domain answers. Its anonymous baseline is its first statement (ADR-0138 D2), and its `405` carries its own `Allow`. Any other unmatched request is handled as before: the declarative-endpoint step, then the adapter's 404/405.
  3. **Absence is loud.** A transport with the fallback seam but no `resolveMountedRoute` keeps the adapter's answer on those paths, and the boot says so once, at `warn`, with the consequence and the remedy. The existing no-`setFallbackHandler` warning names the same consequence in one more clause.
- Pins (real Hono socket, `HonoServerPlugin` + `createDispatcherPlugin`, CORS off):
  - new `packages/runtime/src/actions-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts` (79 cases): three path shapes on both prefixes. For `GET`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` and `TRACE`, an anonymous call gets `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, `error.httpStatus` 401, no `error.details` and no `Allow`. A signed-in call gets `405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, `Allow: POST`, `error.httpStatus` 405 and no `error.details`, which is the domain's door and not the adapter's. `HEAD` is checked by status and header. Anonymous `OPTIONS` gets the domain's `405` + `Allow: POST` (see Acceptance notes). Controls: anonymous `POST` 401 unchanged, and a four-segment path stays the adapter's 404.
  - `keys-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`: `OPTIONS` and `TRACE`, 4 cases (anonymous 401 no `Allow`; signed-in domain 405 with `Allow: POST`).
  - `notifications-every-verb.hono.integration.test.ts`: `OPTIONS` and `TRACE` on each face, 12 cases (anonymous 401; signed-in the dispatcher's `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, no `Allow`).
  - `mcp-skill-method-not-allowed.hono.integration.test.ts`: its `PUT` boundary case pinned the adapter's `Allow` `['DELETE', 'GET', 'HEAD', 'POST']`, which is the defect. It is replaced by `PUT`, `PATCH`, `OPTIONS` and `TRACE` getting the domain branch's `405` with `Allow: GET`.
  - `dispatcher-plugin.fallback-absence-warn.test.ts`: the new warning, once at `warn`, and silence when the resolver exists.
  - `domains/keys-actions-method-not-allowed-allow.test.ts` (PR #24227's pin, the control): **assertions unchanged, still green**. Its docblock and one title said the standalone `/actions` 405 is the adapter's because `GET` is not mounted. After this change that is false, so the wording now says it is the domain's, through the fallback seam.
- `.changeset/24228-actions-every-verb-anonymous-floor.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` `patch`.

Not touched: `packages/spec` (the `IHttpServer` contract line included), `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server`, `domains/actions.ts`, the `dispatcher.dispatch(… req.body …)` sites (no existing mount changed), `readGatedSessionUser`, `route-ledger.ts` (no route is mounted, so no row and no census move).

## The route, and why it is not refusal-only mounts (H2, measured)

- **The adapter cannot tell a refusal-only mount apart.** Its `Allow` is `allowedMethodsForPath` over `registeredRoutes`, and only `get`/`post`/`put`/`delete`/`patch(path, handler)` fill `registeredRoutes`. Nothing in that signature marks a mount as refusal-only. A marker would have to ride on the handler object, which is a cross-package protocol the contract does not declare, or be a new parameter, which is a `packages/spec` change. This PR takes neither.
- **The adapter does not need to tell them apart.** Its unmatched answer is the only producer of the wrong `Allow`. That answer runs after the fallback seam declines. So if the domain answers every request the router cannot route on its paths, the adapter never builds an `Allow` there. This is the first candidate in H2. It needs no `packages/spec` change and no adapter change, and the contract line stays true where the adapter does answer.
- **Why not the `/keys` shape for `/actions`.** With the five `IHttpServer` verbs mounted, a verb `IHttpServer` cannot register still reaches the adapter. That is `OPTIONS` when CORS is off. It is also `TRACE` or an extension method such as `PROPFIND` **with CORS on too**, because CORS answers only `OPTIONS`. The adapter's `Allow` there is every registered verb. So refusal-only mounts on `/actions` would turn today's accurate `Allow: POST` into `DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT`. With the fallback the four mounts are not needed. One mechanism covers every verb on `/actions`, and it covers the verbs left over on the families that already have the mounts.

## Measured

Standalone composition in process: `LiteKernel`, a fake `auth` that answers a session only for a test header, `HonoServerPlugin` on a real socket, `createDispatcherPlugin`, and `registerShareLinkRoutes` at `kernel:ready`. Four compositions: CORS off or on, each with project scoping off or on (`enableProjectScoping: true` mounts both prefixes). For each, 14 paths × 9 verbs (`GET HEAD POST PUT PATCH DELETE OPTIONS TRACE PROPFIND`) × anonymous and signed in, through raw `node:http`. That is 1008 requests at base `2bcd406a2` and 1008 at head `d60989609`. The implementation blob `24648a251fc8` has been the same from there to the final head `6c8625968`. 368 rows changed. Every changed row was the adapter's `405` at base and is the domain's answer at head: 148 now `401`, 172 now the domain's `405`, 30 now the dispatcher's `404`, and 18 `HEAD` rows went from `405` to `401`. No served answer moved.

**H1, confirmed.** At base, every anonymous `GET`/`HEAD`/`PUT`/`PATCH`/`DELETE`/`TRACE`/`PROPFIND` on all three `/actions` shapes and both prefixes got `405` + `Allow: POST` with the adapter's `error.details`, CORS on and off. `OPTIONS` got the same with CORS off and `204` with CORS on.

| `/api/v1/actions/task/close` (all shapes, both prefixes alike) | base | head | `createHonoApp` |
|---|---|---|---|
| anonymous `GET` `PUT` `PATCH` `DELETE` `TRACE`/`PROPFIND` | `405`, `Allow: POST`, adapter | `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, no `Allow` | `401`, no `Allow` |
| anonymous `HEAD` | `405`, `Allow: POST` | `401`, no `Allow` | `401` |
| signed-in non-`POST` | `405`, `Allow: POST`, adapter envelope | `405`, `Allow: POST`, domain envelope | `405`, `Allow: POST` |
| anonymous `OPTIONS`, CORS off | `405`, `Allow: POST`, adapter | `405`, `Allow: POST`, domain | `405`, `Allow: POST` |
| `OPTIONS`, CORS on | `204` | `204` | `204` |

The `createHonoApp` column: `createHonoApp({ kernel, prefix: '/api/v1' })` over the same fake `auth`, driven with `app.request`, CORS off and on. `PROPFIND` stands in for `TRACE` there, because the fetch `Request` refuses `TRACE`.

**H3, the `Allow` each refusal-only family answers** (a verb no route takes: `OPTIONS` with CORS off, `TRACE`/`PROPFIND` with CORS either way, and on `/mcp/skill` also `PUT`/`PATCH`):

| family | served | `Allow` at base | at head |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/keys` | `POST` | `DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT` | anonymous `401` no `Allow`; signed-in domain `405` `Allow: POST` |
| `/notifications` | `GET` | `DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT` | anonymous `401`; signed-in `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`; no `Allow` |
| `/notifications/read` | `POST` | same six | same as above |
| `/notifications/read/all` | `POST` | same six | same as above |
| `/mcp/skill` | `GET` | `DELETE, GET, HEAD, POST` | domain `405` `Allow: GET` |
| `/actions` (3 shapes × 2 prefixes) | `POST` | `POST` (accurate; the defect was the missing 401) | domain `Allow: POST` signed in; anonymous `401` |
| `/share-links` (root) | `GET`, `POST` | `GET, HEAD, POST` | unchanged, measured-clean |
| `/share-links/abc` | `DELETE` | `DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT` | **unchanged**, see Acceptance notes |
| `/share-links/abc/resolve` | `GET` | same six | **unchanged**, see Acceptance notes |

The head column matches the `createHonoApp` answers row for row on `/actions`, `/keys`, `/notifications/read` and `/mcp/skill` for `GET`/`PUT`/`OPTIONS`/extension verbs. Two exceptions predate this PR and are listed in Acceptance notes.

**H4, confirmed.** PR #24227's pin is green with its assertions unchanged. Its standalone `/actions` row (`405`, `Allow: POST`) now reads the domain's answer instead of the adapter's.

## Tests

- Targeted pins at `194b25dc2`. The runtime tree at `194b25dc2` equals the final head for every file this PR touches, and the implementation blob is the same (`24648a251fc8`). Command: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` over the six touched test files plus `dispatcher-plugin.routes`, `share-links-every-path`, `dispatcher-plugin.endpoint-fallback` and `dispatcher-plugin.streaming-fallback`. Result: `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 234 passed (234)`.
- Full suite at the final head `6c8625968`, after merging `origin/main` and rebuilding (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/hono...'`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` gives `Test Files 413 passed (413)`, `Tests 6411 passed | 19 skipped (6430)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` at `6c8625968`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK` with the ledger unchanged. All six touched test files are in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFiles`).
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the seven changed `.ts` files: exit 0.
- `test:repo` (the `repo` vitest project) was not run locally. No file of that project changed, and CI's `Test Core` runs it.

**Ablations** (one per member, not kept). Each ran after the fix was committed, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, inside a script that also carries an EXIT/INT/TERM trap restoring from `HEAD`. Every pin imports `./dispatcher-plugin.js` from source, and `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` (read from its `dist/`) is not mutated, so no `dist/` of the mutated module sits on the resolution path.

- Member 1: the three `/actions` declarations replaced by a marker. The anchor went 1 to 0 and the blob `24648a251fc8` to `4bcfc24a0ac7`. Result: `Tests 72 failed | 27 passed (99)` over the actions pin, the keys pin and PR #24227's control. The 72 are every anonymous, signed-in, `HEAD` and `OPTIONS` row of the actions pin (`expected 405 to be 401`, `expected undefined to be 405`). Green: its 6 `POST` controls, its 404 control, the keys pin and the control file. Restore: blob equals `HEAD` (`24648a251fc8`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the marker count is 0.
- Member 2: the `/keys`, `/notifications` and `/mcp/skill` declarations, three nested anchors, each 1 to 0 (blob `24648a251fc8`, then `1bfef7b8cabc`, then `970cf8d3dba7`, then `258148332710`). Result: `Tests 20 failed | 124 passed (144)`. The 20 are the new `OPTIONS`/`TRACE` rows and the four `/mcp/skill` rows. Messages include `expected 'DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT' to be 'POST'`, `expected 'DELETE, GET, HEAD, POST' to be 'GET'`, `expected 405 to be 401` and `expected 405 to be 404`. The actions pin stayed green. Restore was proven at each of the three levels (blob equals `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` is empty).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at the final head `6c8625968` derived 62 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe and recorded as `COMMAND :: exit N`. `--ran` reconciles: `62 derived, 61 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. The 61 that ran exit 0, `check:route-envelope` and `check:nul-bytes` among them.

- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** Reason: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3). It reads the built `dist/` of every package, 39 have none in this worktree, and the whole repository was not built locally. This diff changes no `exports`, no `package.json` and no build config. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- Not run: `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` (no exported symbol renamed or removed), and the local-only `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` (nothing under `packages/spec` or the skill frame changed). The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is the PR's `Lint & Repo Gates` check-run.

## Acceptance notes

- **`/share-links/*` still lists refusal-only verbs in `Allow`.** On the standalone server `/share-links` is `plugin-sharing`'s family (`registerShareLinkRoutes`), not the dispatcher's. Its `${base}/*` catch-all is mounted for the five verbs. So `OPTIONS` with CORS off, and `TRACE`/`PROPFIND` with CORS either way, on `/api/v1/share-links/abc` (served: `DELETE`) and `/api/v1/share-links/abc/resolve` (served: `GET`) get the adapter's `405` with `Allow: DELETE, GET, HEAD, PATCH, POST, PUT`. This holds at base and at head. The route here does not reach it: the fallback seam is one handler and the dispatcher's, and a dispatcher answer on `/share-links` would be a second owner of that surface. `plugin-sharing` is outside this claim's file surface. Reported to the seat with the options.
- **Anonymous `OPTIONS` on `/actions` (CORS off only)** gets the domain's `405` + `Allow: POST`. That is the same answer as on a `createHonoApp` host. The shared anonymous decision lets every `OPTIONS` through as a CORS preflight, and `domains/actions.ts` is read-only here. This is PR #24227's open question, unchanged.
- **Answers the fallback writes skip the per-route instrumentation.** There is no `X-Request-Id` echo, because the seam is installed on the raw server. That is the same as the adapter answer it replaces, and the transport's response observation still labels them unmatched.
- **Divergences that predate this PR and are unchanged by it:**
  - `HEAD /api/v1/mcp/skill` gets `501` on the standalone server (Hono serves `HEAD` from the `GET` route) and `405` + `Allow: GET` on `createHonoApp`.
  - The signed-in non-face `/notifications` 404 is `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` on the standalone server and `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` on `createHonoApp`, as #24024's notes record.
- **The adapter's own matcher and the Hono router disagree on the `/share-links` root.** Hono routes `PUT /api/v1/share-links` to the `/share-links/*` catch-all, but the adapter's `matchesRoutePattern` does not count that pattern for the root. So `Allow` there lists only `GET, HEAD, POST`, which happens to be accurate. Read from the measurement, no wrong answer. Carrier: none.
